passage:
F: My demo notes say to put the sample in the slot on the left. The stand has been turned around so visitors can see the controls.
M: From their side, the slot is now on the right. Say “the slot next to the guide rail” instead. The rail travels with the stand, so that description works from either side.
F: Should I say that as the group comes up to the stand?
M: Wait until I say “ready for the sample.” We use that same cue after each group has had a look at the controls.

M：從他們那側看，進料口現在在右邊。改說「導軌旁的進料口」。導軌會跟著展示台轉，從哪一側看都能用這個說法。
F：參觀團體一走到展示台時，我就要說嗎？
M：等我說「可以放樣品了」。每組都先看過控制裝置，我們才用這句相同的提示。
